text_blocks.snippet: No, COVID-19 is not a permanently incurable disease. While some individuals experience persistent symptoms known as long COVID, it is not inherently a permanent condition for everyone. For many, long COVID symptoms improve over time, and ongoing research is aimed at developing better treatments and understanding the underlying causes to aid in recovery.
